subject: Rotary sync: aligning demo windows and proposing rotating time slots
messages:
From: Emily Tran <emily.tran@novacorp.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novacorp.com>, Novacorp Scheduler <scheduling@novacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery (Novacorp / Redwood) — follow-ups

Thanks for the quick rundown earlier. A couple clarifying points from our side:
- We have stakeholders in SF, Dublin, and Sydney who want to be present for the technical deep-dive.
- Preferred day is the week of Aug 9–13; mornings PST work best for our Eng and Product execs.
- We need a 90-minute slot for demo + Q&A.

Can you propose a few rotating windows that let our teams join without forcing anyone into late-night? We may need to alternate times across subsequent sessions.

Emily
Senior PM, Novacorp

--
Novacorp scheduling: scheduling@novacorp.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Tran <emily.tran@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Novacorp Scheduler <scheduling@novacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Rotary sync: aligning demo windows and proposing rotating time slots

Hey Emily — great to meet you on the call. Appreciate the constraints, and we can absolutely design a rotating cadence so no single region is always inconvenienced. Summary + proposal below.

Quick recap (so internal stakeholders are aligned):
- Discovery call: Novacorp is evaluating Redwood for low-latency inference across multi-region customers; key concerns were cross-region routing, data isolation, and predictable costs.
- Requirements: 90-minute technical deep-dive with infra folks + product; hands-on perf numbers; can look at a short canary rollout plan.

Rotating windows proposal (week of Aug 9–13):
- Option A (Americas-friendly week):
  - Session 1: Tue Aug 10, 09:00–10:30 PDT (US morning / EU afternoon / APAC late night)
  - Session 2: Thu Aug 12, 22:00–23:30 PDT (APAC morning / EU late afternoon / US late evening)
  - Pattern: rotate each week so the second week the morning favors EU, third week favors APAC.

- Option B (Even distribution): three 90-minute sessions spaced: Mon/E Wed/Fri small rotation so each region sees at least one friendly time in a 3-week window.

Attachments: I attached a simple matrix (redwood_rotating_slots_v1.xlsx) showing local times for SF/Dublin/Sydney and recommendations for who to include in each session. Also attached discovery-notes-novacorp.pdf.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Pick Option A or B (or ask me to tailor).
2) Scheduler to confirm up to two preferred session candidates.
3) Karthik will prepare perf slice and Grace will run through rollout options.

If you prefer, we can publish a shared calendar with rotating invites and a single joining link that auto-swaps time blocks.

Thanks — will be hands-on to lock this down quickly.

— Soojin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_rotating_slots_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
Attachment: discovery-notes-novacorp.pdf (summary, 3 pages)

From: Novacorp Scheduler <scheduling@novacorp.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Emily Tran <emily.tran@novacorp.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novacorp.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 14:35:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Rotary sync: aligning demo windows and proposing rotating time slots

Hi all — thanks, Soojin. We can hold these tentative:
- Tue Aug 10, 09:00 PDT — Tentative (Emily, Eng lead tentative)
- Thu Aug 12, 22:00 PDT — Tentative (Sydney team confirmed)

Emily asked that we prioritize the Tue morning slot if we can only confirm one. If you can lock speakers for Tue (Karthik for perf + Grace for rollout), we'll mark it as confirmed and send invites.

Also, Novacorp prefers rotating invites with a standard Zoom link (we'll accept recurring invites if you label them 'rotating demo cadence — week A/B/C').

Scheduler

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Tran <emily.tran@novacorp.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Novacorp Scheduler <scheduling@novacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 02:41:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Rotary sync: aligning demo windows and proposing rotating time slots

Thanks — locking Tue Aug 10, 09:00 PDT as confirmed from our side. I'll bring a short perf deck and the following:
- 15-min architecture + routing overview
- 25-min live perf demo (latency & throughput, multi-region)
- 20-min canary + rollback playbook (Grace will cover operational steps)
- 30-min Q&A / next steps

I'll share slides and a trimmed perf run (10k token sample) by EOD Aug 9. Soojin — can you publish the recurring calendar with rotating labels (Week A / Week B) and include the shared drive link to the attachments? Scheduler — please send the invite once we publish.

— Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
